page.overview:
Who is Merana Ambrey?

Merana Ambrey is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah., Merana Ambrey}} She is notable for being the one initially put in charge of the Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn.

Merana is on the slim side of a medium build, with dark hair and hazel eyes. She is about 5'4 tall.

Merana is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of .

She is above the stated minimum strength to be able to Travel.
